project.name: UI form
project.description: Build a form from reusable components.

quests.title: Component foundation
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Conventions — Document shared styling and component interfaces.

quests.title: Button
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Interaction — Support keyboard and pointer activation.

quests.title: Text input
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Input — Accept and expose text changes.

quests.title: Label
quests.description: Create a label for form controls.
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Association — Link labels to their controls.

quests.title: Form integration
quests.description: Combine the components into an accessible form.
quests.acceptanceCriteria: - Integration — The form uses all three components and supports keyboard submission.
